_what: Campaign experiment number (results/expN, launcher --exp N, the exp column of every artefact) mapped to the experiment number the manuscript prints. Campaign numbers identify runs and artefacts and never change; manuscript numbers follow the order of the argument. Table generators and the README read this file, so the two numberings are joined in one place.
_decided: 2026-10-04, by the author: manuscript experiments numbered consecutively in order of appearance; a study inside another experiment's section carries no number of its own. 2026-10-16, by the author: the low-threshold study (campaign 8) is no longer reported, and the pruning-layer ablation (campaign 2) is reported together with the attribution study (campaign 9) as one experiment; a campaign the manuscript does not report has manuscript null.
